name: bare-http-parser
reason: The package describes HTTP request/response streaming, and exploratory use of its exported push(Buffer) returned method and URL. Its README does not document that input API; publication-level API evidence remains open.

name: hparser
reason: Its socket-based HTTP parsing API is not documented clearly in the package README; no successful control adapter is recorded.

name: http-parser
reason: Exploratory new HttpHeader(Buffer) parsed the control, but the package README only names the project and does not document that input API.

name: http-request-parser
reason: The README documents parse(rawString), but the release rejected the valid origin-form CRLF request control. Its documented example uses LF and an absolute target; a passing valid-wire adapter has not been established.

name: @caido-utils/parser
reason: The release parsed the valid request control in an exploratory run, but its npm release metadata and tarball contain no open-source license evidence. The npm README also names a Parser export absent from the pinned release.

name: parsley
reason: The old package's documented stream API crashed on Node.js 26.10.0 while parsing the valid request control; no passing pinned-environment adapter exists.

name: silence-js-parser
reason: The package describes an HTTP request parser, but published documentation does not establish a raw HTTP/1.1 byte or stream input API and no control run passed.

name: velociradix
reason: The package advertises a native HTTP engine, but its documented API has not established a local raw-message parser adapter; exploratory import did not terminate without interruption.

name: http-cache-semantics
reason: Parses cache-related header values supplied as fields, not a raw HTTP/1.1 message.

name: http-deceiver
reason: Alters behavior of Node's existing HTTP parser; it does not expose its own local message parsing API.

name: cookie-parser
reason: Parses Cookie values on an already parsed request object, not HTTP wire messages.

name: @hapi/subtext
reason: Parses HTTP payloads after message framing, not the HTTP/1.1 start line and headers from raw input.

name: accept-language-parser
reason: Parses only the Accept-Language header value.

name: curl-trace-parser
reason: Parses curl trace output and extracts raw HTTP text; this is not an HTTP/1.1 message parser API.

name: @midwayjs/serverless-http-parser
reason: Converts an API Gateway trigger event into a Koa context; input is a pre-parsed event, not raw HTTP/1.1 bytes.

name: request-parser
reason: Wraps an already parsed Node request to parse body fields; no wire-message parser API.

name: raw-body
reason: Collects an already framed request body as bytes without parsing HTTP/1.1 start line or headers.

name: llhttp
reason: The npm release is an LLVM/TypeScript parser generator rather than a documented JavaScript raw-message parsing API.

name: http-parse
reason: The available npm release is a security holding package with no parser implementation.

name: parse-http
reason: No npm release was available under this lead name at the search date.

name: http-parser-wasm
reason: No npm release was available under this lead name at the search date.
